what: Proof that the s15 primary detector lists (LEVELCHECK_MODEL.md s15) hold zero G3 test / hold / excluded persons, as person or as pose donor, by two code-independent derivations plus the checkpoint-side gate.

lists.box_convention: vertebral BODY (A28) for every vertebra; whole-bone box for the sacrum

check_1_g3_detector_lists.tool: tools/g3_detector.py lists (keyer: tools/patient_keys.key_any, the keyer tools/eval_gate.py uses; folded raw_to_group -> group_of; side_of_person alone)
check_1_g3_detector_lists.eval_gate_keying: eval_gate.key_items keyed 308 distinct keys (= 288 train + 20 val persons)
check_1_g3_detector_lists.not_listed_because_pose_donor_not_train: 3,242 styled renders of train persons whose C-arm pose came from a test/hold/val real frame were left out (largest: deepfluoro 17-1905 test 420, 17-1882 val 1662); 1,118 styled renders of val persons unused (selection is on real frames)

check_2_independent_intersection.tool: tools/g3_leak_intersect.py (no patient_keys: persons read from split_final.json namespaces and item_side alone; pose donors parsed from the render stem's pose tag)
check_2_independent_intersection.agrees_with_check_1: entries (11264/341), per-device frame counts, persons (288/20) and pose donors (219) identical

check_3_checkpoint_gate.tool: tools/eval_gate.py assess / assert_unseen, run by tools/g3_detector.py post (job 40436992; the gate section completed before the KeyError below)
check_3_checkpoint_gate.validation_roots_declared_not_held_out: carmlspine_g3body#val overlap 10 = the 10 G3 validation persons, by design (checkpoint selection); reported as validation recall only

verdict: PASS: zero test / hold / excluded persons in either list by both derivations; checkpoint chain is COCO yolo11m -> det_g3_primary_s0 only; every Figure 6 set person is held out of it
not_known: the training job's own dataloader was not audited (ultralytics reads train.txt/val.txt as written; the train stage refuses unless the lists are byte-identical to what LEAK_PROOF.json hashed, so the proof covers what was trained on)
